items: What You Get - 2×32-inch plant stakes and 1 roll of soft plant ties. The specially designed ties gently secure stems without leaving marks. Made of premium coated steel, these plant trellises offer exceptional durability, outperforming ordinary supports with better pressure and rust resistance.

Reliable Stability - This indoor plant trellis is specially designed for climbing plants like Monstera, Pothos, and Philodendron! Say goodbye to messy, drooping vines and provide your plants with professional vertical support to create a neat, well-organized green space

Tool-Free Assembly - So easy even beginners can set it up effortlessly. We've simplified every step to make assembly as fun and easy as building blocks. Just snap the pieces together and you're done - no more struggling with complicated instructions or searching for tools

Expandable Design - Each plant support consists of two 16-inch sections that combine to form a 32-inch support. As your plant grows, you can easily extend or adjust the trellis to perfectly support every growth stage - saving you the trouble of repeated purchases

Universal Compatibility - Designed to fit most indoor and outdoor plant pots seamlessly. Whether decorating your living room, office, patio, or garden, it blends perfectly into any space while supporting various climbing plants
